# Nix

Full rules, evidence and examples: `common/languages/nix.md`.

- NIX-01 must: Describe and review Nix at a high level only: layout, option schema, data flow, secrets, pinning and checks; do not prescribe expression-level style beyond the formatter.
  Good: "Each host imports one flat module list; secrets come from sops; inputs are pinned in `flake.lock`."
  Bad: "Replace `optionalAttrs` with `mkIf` and avoid `with pkgs;`."
- NIX-02 prefer: Put the flake in `nix/` with `modules/` (one file per concern), `modules/options/` (schema), `hardware/` and `tests/`; keep `modules/default.nix` a flat import list with a one-line header.
- NIX-03 lean: Name modules after the concern in one lowercase noun, kebab-case for compounds, subdirectories for sub-areas.
- NIX-04 prefer: Gate features with `<x>.enable` options. Observed: drive every host or site from one typed option namespace (`router.*`, `dev.*`) declared in `modules/options/`, and let modules read only `config.<ns>`.
- NIX-05 lean: Give every option a type and a short description with unit, reason or the meaning of `null`; build repeated shapes with small helpers in a plain-function `types.nix`.
- NIX-06 prefer: Keep generated site and host data out of module code: a data flake input (`flake = false`) with fixtures as default, overridden by the tooling; tests always run on committed fixtures.
- NIX-07 prefer: Nix: never put secret values in Nix or the data input; declare only name, owner, mode and reload command and fail activation if a declared file is missing (PRIN-26).
- NIX-08 prefer: Pin inputs to a stable nixpkgs release, set `inputs.nixpkgs.follows` on other inputs, let Renovate propose release bumps, and take single newer packages from an unstable input through an explicit argument (`pkgsUnstable`).
- NIX-09 prefer: Make nixfmt, deadnix and statix blocking checks. Observed: ship flake checks that run offline on fixtures (lint with shellcheck, per-host evaluation, eval tests) and enforce invariants with `assertions`.
- NIX-10 lean: Write comments as a short header with the file's contract and inline comments only for a why (race, security, nixpkgs quirk); see PRIN-15, PRIN-19.
- NIX-11 lean: Let Pulumi generate per-host keys, secrets and `vars.nix`, let Nix consume them as input, share no logic across the boundary, and run Nix through a thin wrapper script.
